_comment: English body for microsoft-365-copilot; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Microsoft Copilot; the specific model and tier vary by Microsoft 365 edition, region and enterprise contract, and the product page does not name a single model.
axes.runtime: Runs in Microsoft 365’s cloud, with entry points in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and the Copilot app; the local client handles the interface and document editing.
axes.local_files: Can read documents, email, meetings and chat context in OneDrive and SharePoint; whether an unuploaded local file enters context depends on the client and tenant policy.
axes.background: Meeting notes and email summaries are triggered inside the relevant app; there is no general “keep running after shutdown” background agent, and long work stays within a session.
axes.tools: Deep integration with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint; Copilot Studio extends custom tools and connectors.
axes.context: Context comes from Microsoft Graph and tenant content the user can access; cross-app memory is bounded by tenant permissions, retention policy and user authorisation.
axes.permissions: Tenant admins control availability, data boundary and logs; commercial use depends on the Microsoft 365 contract and Copilot licence, not the personal-edition description.
axes.fit: Fits: document drafting, email summaries, meeting follow-up and spreadsheet assistance for teams already in Microsoft 365. Does not fit: treating it as a cross-organisation general search engine.

runs: This site has not completed measured task runs for this entry. We checked the official product, help and terms pages and recorded capabilities, data paths and known limits.
